semiconductor_relevance: High — PILLAR Corporation provides critical fluid control and sealing solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: PILLAR Corporation specializes in fluid control systems and sealing solutions for the semiconductor industry, offering a wide range of products including PFA/PTFE fittings, pumps, and heat exchangers. Their engineering expertise allows for custom solutions tailored to optimize fluid delivery and manufacturing processes.
capabilities: PFA/PTFE fittings and tubing for chemical delivery systems
Bellows pumps designed for reliability and field repairability
Heat exchangers with enhanced surface areas for compact designs
Mechanical seals and gaskets for fluid containment

regional_presence.India: PILLAR is committed to supporting the growth of the semiconductor ecosystem in India with trusted fluid-control and engineering solutions.
